{{recipesummary
| Category = Beverages
| Servings = 5
| Time = 5 minutes
| Difficulty = 1
| Energy = 
| Rating = 
}}This is a quick and easy homemade '''orange soda''' recipe.

==Ingredients==
*2¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (560 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 19 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]], warm or room temperature
*2¾ cups (650 ml / 625 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.38 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 oz (30 ml / 28 g) orange juice concentrate or orange syrup
*[[Cookbook:Carbonated Water|Carbonated water]], as needed

==Procedure==
#Combine the water and sugar in a 2-quart or larger saucepan.
#Stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves into a syrup, then remove from the heat.
#Stir the orange juice concentrate into the syrup.
#Using a [[Cookbook:Funnel|funnel]], transfer the syrup to an empty bottle and let it cool.
#To make the finished syrup, mix one volume of syrup with one volume of carbonated water.
